get.description:
Configuration of DHCP-Snooping.
DHCP-Snooping is a security feature to help avoid the "Denial of
Service"/"man in the middle" attacks that result from unauthorized users
adding a DHCP server to the network that then provides invalid
configuration data to other DHCP clients on the network.

put.summary: Create or Update existing DHCP-Snooping profile configuration

ArubaDhcpSnooping_Dhcpv6GuardPolicies.description:
Grouping of DHCPv6 guard policy parameters.
A DHCPv6 guard policy may contain the following filters:
* DHCPv6 server match criteria can make use of an access list.
* Match criteria for IPv6 addresses/prefixes assigned by DHCPv6 servers.
* Allowed DHCPv6 server preference range.
If there are no filters applied then all the server traffic on
DHCPv6-Snooping trusted ports are allowed.

match-client.description: Prefix-list to match client IPv6 address

preference.description: Allowed preference value associated with the DHCPv6 server
